layers.name: photo
layers.notes: Full-bleed 9:16 frame. Connect Bulk Create column `image`. Add Animate → Pan and zoom (Ken Burns), duration 30s.

layers.name: scrim
layers.notes: Black gradient over the lower third so text stays readable.

layers.name: handle
layers.notes: Top center, y≈96. Optional Bulk Create column `handle`.

layers.name: title
layers.notes: Lower third. Connect Bulk Create column `title`.

layers.name: hook
layers.notes: Under title. Connect Bulk Create column `hook`.

layers.name: audio
layers.notes: Do NOT use Canva Pro (crown) audio or Popular/chart songs. Uploads → upload royalty_free_30s.mp3 (original CC0-style bed shipped in this repo) or any other CC0/Pixabay/Mixkit/YouTube Audio Library track you have rights to. Drop it on the timeline, trim 0:00–0:30, fade the last second. Leave it on the template so every bulk copy inherits it.

bulk_create.recommended_path: Canva Sheets → select range → Actions → Bulk Create designs (Sheets are not capped at 300 rows).
bulk_create.fallback_path: Apps → Bulk Create → Upload data. Split into 300 + remainder xlsx files from this repo.
bulk_create.image_rule: Images must be Place-in-Cell embeds in the xlsx/Sheet (xlsxwriter embed_image). Public image URLs and floating Excel pictures are ignored.

export.before_export: Because the bed is royalty-free (not Canva Pro audio), you do not need Canva's Pro-music license or connected social accounts for the soundtrack. Keep Pro/Popular Canva tracks off the design.
